paper_title: First results from a microwave cavity axion search at 24 micro-eV
coupling_convention: |g_agammagamma| in GeV^-1 (axis in units of 10^-14 GeV^-1, multiplier applied)
notes: First results from the Yale/HAYSTAC microwave cavity haloscope. Paper excludes |g_agamma| >~ 2e-14 GeV^-1 (equivalently |g_gamma| >~ 2.3x KSVZ) over 23.55 < m_a < 24.0 ueV (5.7-5.8 GHz, TM010 mode) at >=90% confidence. The detailed frequency-dependent limit is only in Fig. 3 (not tabulated), so the average quoted value from the text is encoded as a flat line across the stated mass range.
